Multi-view text classification through integrated RNN autoencoder learning of word, sentence, emotion and paragraph representations
Text classification performance can be constrained by single-view approaches that process documents through a single representational lens and struggle to capture the multi-dimensional nature of textual information. We propose FMV-RNN-AE (Feature integration Multi-View RNN Autoencoder), an end-to-end framework that systematically integrates four complementary textual views—word-level embeddings, sentence-level representations, emotion-based features, and paragraph-level semantics.
